faqsLeft.a: PartLister is an AI-powered platform that helps automotive parts sellers create professional eBay listings in seconds. It pulls product data, OE references, compatibility info and item specifics automatically from a part number.

faqsLeft.q: How does the Listing Generator work?
faqsLeft.a: Enter an OEM or article number and PartLister fetches product data from TecDoc, generates a structured title, description and item specifics, then formats it ready for eBay — all in under 2 minutes.

faqsLeft.q: What data sources does PartLister use?
faqsLeft.a: PartLister uses TecDoc for technical product data, OE references and vehicle compatibility. Market pricing data is sourced from live eBay sold listings.

faqsLeft.q: Can I export listings in bulk?
faqsLeft.a: Yes. Pro and Business plan subscribers can export multiple listings as a CSV file compatible with eBay's bulk listing import tool.

faqsRight.q: How accurate is the compatibility checker?
faqsRight.a: The compatibility checker uses TecDoc's vehicle fitment database, which covers millions of vehicle/part combinations. Accuracy depends on the completeness of the manufacturer's data.
PartLister supports all automotive parts categories on eBay, including engines, brakes, suspension, electrical, body parts and more.

faqsRight.q: Do you offer a free trial?
faqsRight.a: Yes — every new account includes 10 free listings with no credit card required. You can upgrade at any time from the Pricing page.

faqsRight.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqsRight.a: You can cancel your subscription at any time from the Account page. Your plan remains active until the end of the current billing period.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: PartLister is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your personal data.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body: When you use PartLister, we may collect:
items: Name and email address (at signup)
Account information (plan, preferences, subscription status)
Billing information — processed securely by Stripe; we never see or store your card details
Listings and content you generate within the platform
Saved products and listing preferences
Usage analytics (features used, pages viewed, session behaviour)
Technical data such as IP address, browser type, and device information

notStore.title: Information We Do Not Store
notStore.body: PartLister does not store payment card details. All payment processing is handled securely by Stripe. We only receive confirmation of a successful payment and your subscription status.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
items: To provide, maintain, and improve the PartLister service
To manage your account and subscription
To send transactional emails (account confirmation, billing receipts, password resets)
To send marketing emails, only where you have opted in
To analyse usage patterns and improve the product
To detect and prevent fraud or abuse
To comply with legal obligations

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: We use Google Analytics for page views, traffic sources and usage patterns, and PostHog for feature usage, session behaviour and product analytics.
items: Google Analytics — page views, traffic sources, and general usage patterns
PostHog — feature usage, session behaviour, and product analytics
analytics.after: These tools may collect anonymised data to help us improve the product.

cookies.title: Cookies
items: Authentication — keeping you logged in securely
Security — protecting your session
Preferences — remembering your settings
Analytics — understanding how the platform is used
cookies.after: You can control cookies in your browser. Disabling them may affect some PartLister features.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: PartLister integrates with the following services, each of which processes data under its own privacy policy:
items: Stripe
Supabase
Vercel
Google Analytics
PostHog
eBay APIs
OpenAI

dataSources.title: Data Sources
dataSources.body: Compatibility information, OEM references, pricing insights and other automotive data may come from third-party providers. We work with reputable sources, but you must verify listings before publishing.

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We use industry-standard measures to protect personal data:
items: Encrypted HTTPS connections
Secure cloud infrastructure via Supabase and Vercel
Row-level database security
Internal access controls

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain personal data while your account is active or as needed to provide the service. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise data within a reasonable period unless law requires retention.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: Under UK GDPR and applicable data protection law, you have the right to:
items: Request access to your personal data
Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
Request deletion of your account and data
Withdraw marketing consent
Request a portable copy of your data where applicable
Object to processing in certain circumstances
rights.after: To exercise these rights, contact support@partlister.app.

marketing.title: Marketing Emails
marketing.body: We send marketing emails only when you have explicitly opted in, and every message includes an unsubscribe option. Transactional emails necessary to provide the service are sent regardless of marketing preferences.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy. We will notify you of significant changes by email or a notice in the app. The date at the top shows when this policy was last updated.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact support@partlister.app.

privacy.footerNote: View our Terms & Conditions for information about your rights and responsibilities when using PartLister.

s2.title: 2. Service Description
s2.body: PartLister is a cloud-based platform that helps sellers generate automotive parts listings. Features include:
items: AI-generated titles and descriptions
OEM and interchangeable reference numbers
Vehicle compatibility information
Engine codes
Pricing insights via eBay market data
CSV exports
Other listing automation features

s3.title: 3. Accounts
s3.body: When creating an account, you agree to:
items: Provide accurate and complete information
Keep login credentials secure and confidential
Be responsible for all activity under your account
Notify us immediately of unauthorised use
s3.after: You may not create multiple accounts or share your account without express permission.

s4.title: 4. Subscriptions & Billing
items: Subscription fees are billed in advance monthly or annually
Paid plans renew automatically unless cancelled before renewal
You may cancel at any time from account settings
Paid access continues until the current billing period ends
No refunds except where required by law
Pricing may change with reasonable notice

s5.title: 5. Fair Use
items: Reverse engineer, decompile, or extract PartLister source code

s6.title: 6. Intellectual Property
s6.body: All PartLister software, branding, designs and functionality remain its exclusive intellectual property. You retain ownership of listings and content you create, and grant PartLister a limited licence to process it solely to provide the service.

s7.title: 7. Accuracy & Data Sources
s7.body: PartLister uses trusted automotive data sources and AI to assist with listing creation. However:
items: Third-party automotive data may be incomplete or inaccurate
You are responsible for verifying compatibility, pricing, specifications and applications before listing
PartLister assists creation and does not guarantee accuracy

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
s8.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, PartLister is not liable for:
items: Incorrect or inaccurate listings
Lost sales or revenue
Marketplace penalties, including eBay policy violations
Business interruption
Indirect, consequential, or special losses
s8.after: Where liability cannot be excluded, it is limited to the amount paid for the service in the three months before the claim.

s9.title: 9. Termination
s9.body: We may suspend or terminate your account without notice if you breach these terms, engage in fraud or misuse the platform. You may terminate your account by cancelling your subscription and contacting support.

s10.title: 10. Changes to Terms
s10.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions. Material changes will be notified by email or in-app notice. Continued use after changes take effect means you accept the revised terms.
